rationale: Class 1 batched single-cell review. The raw investment schedule explicitly reports negative cost for representative flagged delayed-draw and revolver rows, and the extracted values match those source cells after the filing's thousands-to-units scaling. Corresponding fair values are also negative, supporting that these are filer-reported position values rather than sign extraction errors. C107 merely treats any negative cost as suspicious, so the flag is a false alarm caused by overbroad rule scope. No aggregate anchor is applicable.
